title: 2018 AMC 10B 20

solutions.text: Notice \(f(n) = n + 1\) solves the recurrence on its own, so write \(f(n) = (n + 1) + g(n).\) Then \(g\) satisfies the homogeneous version \(g(n) = g(n-1) - g(n-2).\) With \(g(1) = -1\) and \(g(2) = -2,\) it cycles with period \(6\): \(-1, -2, -1, 1, 2, 1, \ldots.\) Since \(2018 \equiv 2 \pmod 6,\) we get \(g(2018) = -2,\) so \(f(2018) = 2019 - 2 = 2017.\) Therefore, the answer is B.
hints: Look for a particular solution of the form \(f(n) = n + c;\) subtracting it leaves \(g(n) = g(n-1) - g(n-2)\)
That homogeneous recursion is periodic with period \(6;\) reduce \(2018\) modulo \(6\)
